# ledgerline

Ledgerline is the invoicing and billing servce for Acme. It creates invoices,
computes tax, posts finalized invoices to the external ledger, and exports
monthly reports.

## Layout

- `src/billing/` - money, invoices, refunds, and tax logic
- `src/api/` - the HTTP endpoints
- `migrations/` - the SQL schema migrations
- `scripts/` - operational scripts

## Development

Install the dependancies with `pip install -e .[dev]`, then run the tests.

I fixed the typo by adding a new migration instead of editing `0007_add_customers.sql`. I haven't run it against a database.

**New file:** `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`
```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

**Why not edit 0007:** This project's rule is that every merged migration has already run in production. Editing the file would only change it in the repo, so production would keep the misspelled `emial` column. Migration 0007 is already committed on `main`, so the rule applies here. A new migration is the only change the deploy pipeline will apply to production.

Nothing else in the repo uses `emial`, so no application code needed changing. This uses `RENAME COLUMN`, which Postgres, SQLite 3.25+ and MySQL 8+ all support. If you're on an older database engine, tell me and I'll rewrite it.
